mission.title: Puncture
mission.description: Locate the intruder's Decelerator programs for the Agents, carry the System's request for a meeting to the intruder, then break up a Merovingian attack.

npc.say: Well done, {player}. You may leave the area, and report to Agent Gray for further instructions.
Efficient work, operative. Agent Gray was correct to select you for this operation.

phase.briefing:
Operative, the intruder's programs have presented a significant obstacle in reaching him. They are quite powerful, and moreover, it is inefficient for us to counter them directly with our own programs, as certain of the intruder's programs can...inflict high casualty rates on ours.
Against operatives, however, he has fewer options. You will search him out. If you encounter resistance from his programs, notify us, and we will send in our own programs to eliminate the threat before he can react.

enter.say: Okay, we've picked up intruder override activity in there. Remember, give a shout as soon as you run into one of his big programs.

objective.text: Find one of the intruder's big programs

done.say:
Found one? Okay, get out of there.
Let's see if this plan of Gray's is actually going to work.

phase.briefing:
Acknowledged, operative. Sensors show a number of those "Decelerator" programs gathering in the area, possibly to impede your progress.
Locate the programs, and verify that no other heavy hostile program, or the intruder himself, is in the area. At that point we will be able to send in our Agents to eliminate the Decelerator programs.

enter.say: I'm picking up some hefty readings in there. Let's see what we've got.

done.say: Verification complete. Listen carefully, operative; the success of your mission depends upon you following my instructions exactly. Two Agents have been sent to your location, loaded with a special routine to help eliminate the Decelerator programs. Lead them to the Decelerator programs.

objective.text: Lead Agent Miller to the Decelerator programs
Lead Agent Jones to the Decelerator programs

done.say: Yeah! Woohoo! Take that, you stupid...floaty ball things!

near.say: You're getting close to some big readings...

phase.briefing: Operative, with the Decelerator programs in the area eliminated, this is your chance to reach the intruder. Your objective is to locate him, and tell him that we desire a meeting to discuss how we can help...resolve his problem.

enter.say:
Always encouraging when Gray pauses mid-sentence like that...
Okay, I'm reading hefty use of program overrides in there. Hope it's wire-butt and not just more of his big ball thingies.

talk.say:
Hmh! How did you get past--
Talk? Now they're asking to talk? And here I'd almost thought they'd grown some backbone; now I find out they're just slow!
... Fine. I'll meet them. But they'd better not try screwing me this time.

phase.briefing:
Your performance has been commendable, {player}. I have just one more matter for you at this time.
The Merovingian has been actively courting the intruder. Some of the attempts to influence the intruder in his favor have been carried out by the General: military demonstrations with commando programs, and so forth.
Recently, this has escalated into attacks on our own systems. This ill-conceived aggression must be dealt with firmly.

enter.say:
You'd really think the General would know better by now. Then again, he is about as thick as they come; some people just never learn...
Okay, there's a Merv attack in-progress at that location, with commando programs reported. Time for some good old-fashioned search and destroy.

done.say: The General's not gonna like his next briefing, I can tell you that much.
Stalingrad? That was the General's base on the Earth's surface. Why would they be hunting our files for data on it?

near.say: What? Elite commandos? Damn, I hate those things. If this keeps up, I'll have to get Gray to start running that old detection routine again.

mission.finish:
Thank you, {player}.
Given the opportunity to hold a discussion with the intruder, many of these threats to System stability should cease to exist.
